The bug was in `prices.py`: `price_of` did an exact-match lookup in `PRICES`, so a lowercase product name like `"gadget"` in the CSV didn't match the key `"Gadget"` and raised `LookupError`.

Fix: normalize the lookup key with `product.strip().title()` before checking/indexing `PRICES`, so casing/whitespace differences no longer cause failures.

While verifying, I also found a related off-by-one bug in `invoice.py`'s bulk discount check (`quantity > BULK` excluded orders of exactly 10 units from the discount) and corrected it to `quantity >= BULK`, matching the documented behavior and the test's expected totals.

Tests now pass.
